title: vitex agnus-castus var. trifolia
intro: Vitex agnus-castus var. trifolia, commonly known as Tri-leaf Chaste Tree, is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to support reproductive health and alleviate symptoms associated with menstrual irregularities, menopause, and premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The therapeutic actions of this plant include its estrogen-modulating properties, anti-anxiety effects, and ability to regulate the menstrual cycle. The bioactive constituents of Tri-leaf Chaste Tree include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic benefits.
